caption_text:
I’m super excited to finally begin sharing my work for @datalandmuseum.

For anyone unfamiliar, Dataland is a permanent museum in downtown Los Angeles exploring data and nature through immersive digital art. It was a rare project: enormous in vision, generous in creative freedom, and backed by the commitment needed to carry that vision through. I’m incredibly proud to have collaborated with the multidisciplinary team at @refikanadol Studio that built it.

I’ve been working on Dataland since late 2023. That time has brought together nearly everything I’ve learned throughout my career while constantly pushing me into new territory. Concept development, production, immersive spaces, interfaces, screen graphics and key art - I have literal years of artwork and experiments to share. 

More to come.

caption_text:
Together with @someform.studio we had the pleasure of exhibiting Artificial Spaces at the latest edition of @noorriyadhfestival last November in Riyadh.
A new iteration of this contemplative installation where physical matter and digital light begin to interact as a single system.

At its center, a 25 kg polished marble sphere acts as a small planet that can be rotated and pushed to influence the creation. Its axis slowly shifts while the surrounding space reacts in real time, generating unique environments of light and movement.

Each space is generated live through CGI. Each one appears once, then disappears forever. Born from the beautiful randomness of a machine, fed with 3D models of architectural elements as columns, walls, furniture, objects, and programmed with care to allow the system to decide how the space is formed.

We would like to thank the organization of @noorriyadhfestival, @riyadhartofficial and @nouf.almoneef, as well as the curational team @sara.endipity @lzhenhua and @davide_quadrio @bruno.bolfo for this wonderful opportunity.
To the team involved @markosego03 @_owngmbpnq_ @________josh_________ @nicolo.baldi_ @secondarybounce @olga__sounds

caption_text:
【sf-0524】 samsung, product branding, 2024

Working with the creative team at Samsung’s Headquarter in Seoul, we ventured into an extensive design development phase in order to help our client find the best visual direction of wallpapers being used for the S24 product release. Our focus was exploring various different ideas loosely based on the conceptual topic “Minerals / Crystals”. We ultimately produced the final wallpapers & animations for the Samsung S24 and S24 Ultra series. 

For the premium Samsung S24 Ultra we created minimalistic crystalline shapes that purely live from refracting the lights around them. The result is a complex play of light and reflection, with subtle colour gradients interwoven into the objects.

For the Samsung S24 series we designed a composition consisting of three circular crystal shapes placed into the vertical frame. The playful roundness of the object is contrasted by hints of crystalline structures on their inside.

@samsung @someform.studio #wallpaper #samsungs24 #samsungs24ultra

caption_text:
【sf-0324】Google DeepMind, creative app, 2024

Here is a complete view of the software, from the layout to the final render. All the following images were created using this tool.

After the completion of the design phase of this project for @googledeepmind which yielded the ruleset of a comprehensive 3D design system and a collection of traditionally rendered assets, we continued into the development of the standalone application. This application is poised to leverage the design system, empowering users to craft new images within a consistent visual language. Starting with user experience and user interface, our paramount goal from the outset has been to fashion an app that exudes intuitiveness and approachability. The user experience unfolds through a thoughtfully crafted sequence of steps and chapters, a deliberate design choice that prevents the common pitfall found in comparable software – the overwhelming array of options. The application strikes a balance between user-directed interaction and semi-procedural algorithms, streamlining the often tedious tasks required to achieve a specific visual language. This unique blend ensures the software is not only incredibly user-friendly but also clarifies its functionality as users navigate, all while providing a robust system capable of generating distinctive compositions and layouts. Recognizing that not every user may possess prior experience with 3D packages, we prioritised creating an interface that caters to both novices and seasoned users alike.

【sf-0724】 hyperice, product, 2024

We collaborated with @simsdirector and @hyperice to create visual effects for the transition to the new Normatec Elite. This version removes the separate control unit, making it the most advanced Normatec yet.
